rule_outs: Dwelling 6 m from the best section
summary: Busy Hawken Drive kerb with homes 2-9 m from the whole stretch.

drivers.seclusion: Detached homes sit 2-9 m behind the kerb along the whole stretch; the nearest to the start is 8 m.
drivers.access_and_room: Kerb is on a wide through road; a van can pull to the kerb but there is no verge.
drivers.traffic: Busy through route linking suburbs, with a bus zone.
drivers.convention: 2P parking with resident permits excepted Mon-Fri 7am-6pm; only a couple of cars parked.

flags: Dwellings within 10 m along the whole section
sun_shade: Mostly open to the sky, with tree shade from the south side near the middle.

best_section.where: Hawken Drive north kerb, start of stretch near the side street
